caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden-framed mirror with intricate carving on the top. The frame is brown with visible wood grain texture, consisting of layered molding that surrounds the reflective glass surface in the center. The top of the frame is adorned with a decorative, symmetrical design featuring scrolls and leaf motifs, all rendered in the same brown color as the rest of the frame. The mirror itself appears with a lightly shaded, diagonal reflection pattern. The background is plain, off-white, and in the bottom right corner, the name "ARTHUR JOHNSON" is printed in uppercase letters.
title: Mirror
